name: LRU Cache Management for Octree Nodes
definition: A demand-based page replacement algorithm used for managing the caching of octree nodes. It does not suffer from Belady’s anomaly and provides a good approximation to the optimal algorithm without using pre-paging.
summary: LRU Cache Management for Octree Nodes is a generic, demand-based algorithm that retains recently accessed nodes to optimize memory reuse, serving as a baseline for evaluating specialized out-of-core prefetching strategies.
